findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "get_article" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Fetch a specific Anahana article as markdown, given its full URL, site-relative path (e.g. "/en/angel-numbers/111-angel-number/"), or a bare slug from search_co…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_content, get_article, list_products, get_product, calculate_angel_number · Private data: search_content · Public sink: lookup_angel_number.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_content, get_article, list_products, get_product, calculate_angel_number · Private data: search_content · Public sink: lookup_angel_number

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
